generation.mode: single built-in ImageGen whole-canvas edit with edit-target.png first and the NinjaOne seed canon second as reference only

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin full-angle land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by the uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels and immediate neighbours excluded and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No cast-shadow field or whole-cell sun gradient is visible, but the colonnade repeatedly uses pale top caps over materially darker side faces. The low aggregate directional moment cannot override the literal equal-value rule.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual full-frame estimate as fractions of non-water land at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: The broad coherent cliff-top bench and colonnade-head standing ground count as buildable; the exposed colonnade and immediate coastal drop count as steep; west-edge conifer gullies, talus, boulders and broken margin make up the remainder.

crown.method: Manual full-frame outer-foliage census of all 31 visually distinguishable conifer crowns, including saplings, clipped edge crowns and readable overlapping west-gully crowns; median source width 32 px was scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 0.048 m per final pixel.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: Native-resolution east-edge flood of the connected teal sea, expanded through adjacent pale surf, foam, wash, ripple highlights and reflections; pixel-scale gaps were closed while ten larger enclosed dry basalt crowns and emergent boulder surfaces remain unmasked. The full binary overlay was visually inspected.

refusalReasons: The highest-priority lighting rule fails visually: the repeated pale column caps and darker column sides reveal orientation-dependent form lighting even though there is no cast-shadow field.
The chain reads clearly along the shoreline but does not clearly leave the land and continue outward across open sea; the required colonnade-head last-land/first-sea transition is not distinct.
openRisks: The generated bench occupies roughly 0.84 of non-water land, materially above the territory-wide roughly one-third buildable target, although this biome explicitly asks for a plain cliff-top bench.
The raw edit visually matches the incoming muted ground, but exact neighbour-pixel preservation is delegated to the stitch and is not claimed for the 1254 px generation.
The water mask is same-size, binary, edge-connected and overlay-inspected; exact coastline placement remains a human visual gate.
No shipped-canvas bake or runtime validation was run because the task is quarantine-only, and no artifact was promoted outside quarantine.
recommendedReframe: Do not spend a second call on this candidate. A future attempt needs the offshore continuation and colonnade-head transition made compositionally explicit, plus an authoring path capable of truly equal-value rock faces.
